findings.quoted_text: Company will and hereby does, without further consideration, irrevocably assign to Reed's any and all worldwide right, title or interest that Company may now or hereafter possess in or to the Deliverables in perpetuity (or the maximum period permitted by Applicable Laws and Regulations) and Reed's accepts such assignment.

Company acknowledges and agrees that all Intellectual Property created by Company, its affiliates, representatives, or agents in connection with or resulting from any work or services related to the Products, including the Deliverables ("Work Product"), but excluding the Neutral Alcohol Beverage Base and excluding the Company's general know-how and independently developed production processes not specifically related to the Products, have been specially ordered and commissioned by Reed's, are works-made-for-hire from the moment of creation and that all such Work Product is and will be the sole and exclusive property of Reed's.

Company will and hereby does, without further consideration, irrevocably assign to [PARTY_D] any and all worldwide right, title or interest that Company may now or hereafter possess in or to the Deliverables in perpetuity (or the maximum period permitted by Applicable Laws and Regulations) and [PARTY_D] accepts such assignment.
findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product transfers immediately upon creation without any condition of full payment, meaning you lose your rights to the work even if you are not paid.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Deliverables, the Contractor hereby assigns to the Client all worldwide right, title, and interest in such Deliverables.

findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Work Product shall remain with the Contractor until the Client has paid for the services in full, at which time ownership shall transfer to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. Thank you for sharing the agreement. I have a couple of suggestions regarding the document before we proceed: - Regarding the relevant clause about assignment, ownership transfers immediately upon creation without any condition of full payment, meaning I lose rights to the work even if I am not paid. I propose updating it to: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable Deliverables, the Contractor hereby assigns to the Client all worldwide right, title, and interest in such Deliverables. - Regarding the work-made-for-hire clause, ownership transfers immediately upon creation before payment is guaranteed. I propose modifying it so that: Ownership of the Work Product shall remain with the Contractor until the Client has paid for the services in full, at which time ownership shall transfer to the Client. Please let me know if these updates work for you. Best regards,
